items.source: Creates a new instance for the specified property name and value, including a reason why the value is invalid.
items.translation: 为指定的属性 name` 和 value` 创建新实例，并包含该值无效的原因 reason`。

items.source: Return the invalid value, can be null.
Return the name of the property.
Return the reason why the value is invalid.
value - the value of the property, can be null
name - the name of the property in canonical format
items.translation: name - 规范格式中的属性名称

items.source: reason - a human-readable text that describes why the reason is invalid. Starts with an upper-case and ends with a dot. Several sentences and carriage returns are allowed.
items.translation: reason - 描述该原因无效的人类可读文本。以大写开头，以句号结尾。允许包含多个句子和换行符。

items.source: Exception thrown when a configuration property value is invalid.
items.translation: 配置属性值无效时抛出异常。
